digest.component_or_area: test design standard and convergence test guardrails
propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the send path with composed helpers instead of capturing its actual output fail to detect when the send path drifts.

Two instances of re-derived convergence test oracles went stale when their underlying send paths changed (truncate_comment_body -> AdfCodec.fit_outbound, causing 836 unmarked duplicate comments), while the tests remained green.

The rule that external-effect sides of convergence assertions must be captured from real call sites, not recomputed from the helpers under test, must be documented in the shared test-design standard to make it discoverable and enforceable.

A mechanical lint check to flag tests importing shared fit helpers on both sides of assertions cannot distinguish legitimate characterization tests (which intentionally compare two helpers) from defective re-derived oracles without semantic intent analysis.

The canonical test-design guidance at examples/agent-skills/shared/test-design.md must be synced byte-identically to per-skill copies (rebar-debug, rebar-implement, rebar-brainstorm) and enforced by tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py.
